name: Introduction and overview — AH-1 Cobra — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — AH-1 Cobra
description: Introduction and overview of the AH-1 Cobra: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The AH-1 Cobra is an attack helicopter built by Bell, entering service in 1967 as the first dedicated helicopter gunship. Developed from the UH-1 Huey, it carried rockets, grenade launchers, and anti-tank missiles in Vietnam. Over 1,100 were built; twin-engine SuperCobra versions still serve with the U.S. Marine Corps. Baseline facts: First dedicated helicopter gunship; service from 1967; 1,100+ built by Bell..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
key_points: AH-1 Cobra: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history.
